instruction: Low-angle cinematic wide shot. On a rooftop under a bright sky, five friends stand in a line looking upwards. From left to right: the woman in the white t-shirt (R1) looks up; the woman in the black crop top (R5) touches her hair while looking up; the woman in the denim vest (R3) holds sunglasses up, looking towards the sky; the man in the gray t-shirt (R2) looks up and to the right; and the man in the green jacket and black hat (R4) stands on the far right looking down. Bright sunlight creates a subtle lens flare.
